verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation in the pack covers region selection or data residency controls. Community comments about us-east-1 and region-scoped outages only indirectly show that AWS resources run in user-selected regions (e.g. advice against 'running anything on us-east-1'). Missing for 10: first-party docs on choosing regions per service, data-residency guarantees and controls (e.g. restricting resources to approved regions), and independent corroboration specifically about residency rather than outages.
